description: 한국전자통신연구원_전자통신동향분석 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 한국전자통신연구원(ETRI)에서 발행하고 있는 '전자통신동향분석'은 정보통신분야 전반에 걸친 최신 기술/정책/산업동향을 심층 분석한 전문지로서 격월간으로 발행되고 있으며, 인터넷 상. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 정보통신기술, 전자통신동향, 기술 전망, 인공지능, 반도체. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-01-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
